messages.subject: Is shiny App server down - 500 error, May 24th
parts:
Hello,
 I just got a shinyApps account and I went to sign in with my Google account. I hit a screen where I was asked to give shinyApps access to basic info about my account, so I did. However when I click the "Sign in with Google" button all I get is a screen that says "500: Internal Server Error". Is this some problem on my end, or is the server having issues now?

Thanks

JP

-Andy
